title: When the Vow Burns
author: Quentin Fairweather
blurb: Gideon Eastwick, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. But when a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
